Title: Generally Available: IOPS scaling for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content: We are excited to announce the general availability of IOPS scaling for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server. This feature empowers you to dynamically scale your IOPS based on your workload needs. Ensure optimal performance during high-demand operations like migrations or data loads and scale down to save costs when demand decreases. With IOPS scaling, you can fine-tune database performance and manage costs more effectively without over-provisioning resources. Experience seamless and efficient database management with the flexibility to adjust IOPS as required. Start using IOPS scaling today to enhance your database's performance and efficiency. Visit the Azure portal to get started. Learn more.
